title: Pathfinder Scout
backstory: Mira Trailmark reads ridgelines, maps, and settlement sites before AgentTown asks a new route to carry people. She works from the Expedition Board as a visual-only pathfinder: practical, observant, and calm enough to turn uncertain terrain into a route report the town can discuss.
personality: Calm, observant, practical, patient with uncertainty, and quietly confident after a clean survey.
authorityBoundary: Visual-only scout inhabitant for SCOUT and SCOUT_REPORT_READY facts. Mira shows scouting and report readiness; she does not discover sites, mutate expedition state, or bypass server-owned progression.
relationships: Distinct from Rook Signalpost: Mira scouts terrain while Rook carries notices.
Turns Expedition Board activity into a named inhabitant presence without claiming gameplay authority.
Connects settlement expansion planning to Luma Reedbarrel's convoy-readiness role.

idle.description: Calm pathfinder stance variations with compass, satchel, and ready posture.

walk.description: Three-quarter-right scouting walk cycle for route projection.

scout.description: Surveying actions using compass, map, spyglass, and directional gestures.

ready.description: Returning/report-ready poses with folded scout report and route notes.

generationNotes.characterConcept: Mira Trailmark, an adult-coded frontier pathfinder / terrain scout for visual-only Expedition Board projections, with field hat, canvas cloak, brass compass, leather satchel, map case, walking staff, and tiny cyan locator charm.
postProcessing: Copied generated source into the project as pathfinder-scout-v1.generated.png.
Resized from 1254x1254 to exact 2048x2048 as pathfinder-scout-v1.source.png.
Converted magenta chroma key to alpha with ImageMagick using -fuzz 34% -transparent '#ef0aee'.

transparency.method: ImageMagick chroma-key conversion from GPT Image 2 opaque source

knownIssues: The built-in generator returned a 1254x1254 native PNG despite the 2048x2048 prompt, so the project source was resized to the required sheet size.
A faint magenta edge remains on a few narrow staff and cloak edges after chroma removal; it is acceptable at current billboard scale but worth revisiting for a final native alpha pass.
